Business Updates
Overall budget attainment reached 90.8%, up 2.4 pp on September (88.4%).SZ attained 93.0% of budget, with same-store daily sales −7.6% MoM and −3.7% YoY;SH attained 86.9%, with same-store daily sales +6.7% MoM and +5.0% YoY.Two new SZ stores opened this month — 17 and 15 selling days to date, 134% of budget to date combined (Ruiyinli 181%, Anhuilin 96%), ahead of expectations; details on the following pages.
Product Updates
New Stores
Opening-exclusive range (not carried by existing stores): rice-salt croissant line — plain S7 and German-sausage A6 — plus Fauchon chocolate croissant S18, chocolate muffin A2, cheese & pork-floss sandwich A14 and blueberry toast sandwich A15.
Health-leaning picks: half-sugar strawberry-rose cake B4, half-sugar Dubai-chocolate cake B8, matcha-chocolate keto cake B14 and black-sesame cheese rice lye bun B26.
SABC rankings above are based on combined sales at the 2 new stores only.
Existing Stores · SZ
Dubai Chewy Cookie is the launch of the year: the 2-pc pack graded S2 and the 4-pc gift box S28 — still #1-2 in SZ.
Low-sugar rice bread graded S9; the croissant egg tart S16 plus S35 for the 4-pc pack — both still climbing.
Health line keeps widening: Half Sugar Dark Chocolate Berries Cake A39, Half Sugar Sea Salt Oreo Cake B26 and Half Sugar Colorful Garden Cake B30, in 25–27 days.
Existing Stores · SH
Hand-made rice bread (health line) keeps building: Original S11, Coconut Matcha S20 and Matcha Red Bean S23 — all three in the S grade.
Spicy Crayfish Burger — a hot-food burger co-developed with La Barra — took ¥4,587 in its first month (A26), SH's top launch of the month.
CDF × Ms Green crossover (in 5 days) — its two 100% HPP fruit-and-veg juices are on shelf in SH, ¥3.1k in the first five days.
Vesta stock-outs clearing — the Vesta products that had been out of stock are gradually back on shelf.

Learning & Next Actions
Product & Menu
The wish list is already on shelf — half-sugar cakes, the Dubai cookie, rice bread.
  • Keep the low-sugar line moving — half-sugar new flavours on a regular cadence, rice-bread extensions, Dubai croissant as a limited-time traffic driver.
  • Price alignment: core SKUs at one price across stores; only cost-driven gaps allowed.
  • Bread range: shift from low-price items to better-looking, higher-value products — lift the quality feel of the bread cabinet.
Marketing & Sales SOP
  • Students: capture the nearby student crowd at lunch with a straight, margin-checked discount.
  • Ice cream: standardise the offer and the serving SOP — consistent output, protected volume.
  • In-store: monthly tasting (members first), festive parent-child DIY, weekday coffee + brunch bundle, one neighbourhood group-buy per period.
Operations & Private Domain
  • Staffing: Ruiyinli is running above plan and short-staffed — add 3 more staff (6 on the roster now).
  • Private domain: tighten the opening-event flow to lift offline→online conversion and get the WeChat community running.
CROISSANTERIE · BI-WEEKLY02 / 12

Vesta Supply & Stockouts

Croissant supply — SZ: Vesta formally notified us on Sep 30 that it is at full capacity and cannot produce new products. SZ croissants can therefore only be bridged by an outside supplier — Baxun Food (a BreadTalk South-China factory, croissant fat content adjustable).
This is a short-term emergency fix only — Baxun's lines already run over-saturated; the arrangement keeps the new stores opening on schedule.
Operational Impact: Vesta Product Stockouts

While high-volume enterprise orders remain the priority, ongoing supply constraints at Vesta directly impact SH store revenue.

Because store sales remain heavily dependent on the Vesta product line, stockouts starting August 18 have led to revenue losses.

Other Updates

  • Shucheng — the landlord formally replied in writing on Oct 29; as a state-owned enterprise its internal review takes time, and a formal answer is expected in late November.
  • Our ¥30,000 a month proposal is on the table (current rent ¥100,000; at ~¥200,000 monthly net sales it keeps the occupancy-cost ratio below 18%). Judging by the leasing director's stance, the landlord wants us to stay and is actively pushing for the reduction; if it is not approved we move to closure, with staffing and equipment plans already in place.

Brand Refresh

  • Consolidated feedback sent to design team
  • 2nd-phase design reviewed in SZ (incl. Bloom) — brand colors, packaging & uniform need more work (Aug 20)
  • Packaging design to be confirmed by Aug 21

Other Updates

  • Store layout confirmed
  • Overall concept & key design materials approved
  • Furniture & soft decoration approved
  • Miscellaneous software confirmed; only the kitchen/front divider curtain display is pending — confirm by Aug 20

Mooncake Sales Performance

  • Volume & Revenue: Sold 18,000 boxes, fully meeting budget targets and maintaining flat Year-over-Year (YoY) performance.
  • Market Dynamics: Achieved budget stability despite a ~10% YoY market contraction driven by reduced corporate gifting/procurement budgets and weaker retail consumer demand.
  • Key Growth Driver: Sales included 2,550 boxes secured through a key Vesta supplier, which was critical to bridging the budget target.

Next Half Focus

  • IN City — follow up on the store fit-out
  • Shucheng — follow up on the rent reduction
  • Lujiazui — operating-strategy report
  • Vesta croissant dough — after repeated rounds of discussion, Vesta has agreed to produce a first batch of 9,000 new-recipe croissants (higher butter content) for SH as a stability test; once quality is confirmed stable, production will be extended to SZ. Meanwhile SZ is bridged by Baxun for 1–2 months while we evaluate several suppliers on quality and price before making the final selection. Croissants are our signature product — their quality in the new stores must be assured.
  • Product — finalize the supplier for croissants and Danish pastries
  • Marketing — plan and launch Christmas & New Year products and campaigns
  • People — recruit and onboard SZ store managers and an operations manager
